# Correct the owner of the notification withdrawal callback

The source links in the detailed audit for entry1086 name messageHeaderSink.onDOMContentLoaded. The actual owner at the pinned accepted revision is messageProgressListener.onDOMContentLoaded. The enclosing declaration is msgHdrView.js:525; the inspected method remains at670–712. Use messageProgressListener when locating this callback. This corrects the source-link receiver label only; the inspected notification-withdrawal behavior and audit coverage are unchanged. No new runtime result or extra commit audit is claimed.

Scope: mail/base/content/msgHdrView.js.
